familyFindings: Strongest guides contain actual worked examples, honest source limits and a concrete task; retain these rather than mechanically shortening all pages.
Repeated generic H2s and identical H2/table captions make many workflow pages harder to scan. Rename them for the actual decision.
Several long workflow guides lead with operator-by-operator source narratives. Bring the reusable record or decision forward and attach concise evidence notes.
Some general titles conceal a narrowly local audience; label the location as a worked case or align title and audience.
Repeated approval and no-guarantee statements should remain beside the relevant promise, but repeated full explanations do not need separate sections.
Do not add a visual quota: the high-value candidates are timelines, parallel states, comparison matrices and annotated real or clearly fictional examples.

The Business Profile eligibility CTA needs a clearer boundary with excluded profile verification/account recovery; this is an expectation risk, not a verified false service claim.
